name: Medad
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Two of the men, Eldad and Medad, remained in the camp, and the spirit rested upon them, and they prophesied in the camp. A young man ran and told Moses, and Joshua the son of Nun said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Eldad and Medad
cases.charge: Prophesying in the camp when the spirit rested on them, and being defended by Moses
cases.preview: Moses told the Lord he was not able to bear the people alone, so the Lord took of the spirit that was on him and put it on seventy elders, and they prophesied.
